name: Soft Goose 97
author: PriyanshuGupta28
description: Outlined pill gray checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes -10px -10px 15px #ffffff,
    10px 10px 15px #464646,
    inset -10px -10px 15px #d8d4d4,
    inset 10px 10px 15px #464646, border becomes solid #15bae3, transform becomes rotate(45deg).
